name: Form Weighbridge

business_logic: 1. Load draft record by id (route param) into form state
2. Jika draft baru (weighbridge_type belum ada di record), set weighbridge_type='receive' sebagai default; render tombol tab Type sesuai weighbridge_type saat ini

3. Terapkan logika record_datetime: auto-set record_datetime = waktu saat ini SEKALI HANYA jika masih kosong (draft baru, atau tipe baru saja dipilih/berganti); jika sudah ada nilai tersimpan (draft dilanjutkan, atau tipe sudah pernah di-set sebelumnya), pertahankan nilai tersebut, tidak ditimpa — perilaku ini SAMA untuk weighbridge_type='receive' maupun 'dispatch'

4. On tap tab Type (ganti weighbridge_type): buang nilai record_datetime dan destination saat ini, lalu ulangi langkah 3 untuk tipe baru (auto-set record_datetime sekali untuk tipe baru); jika tipe baru = receive, sembunyikan & kosongkan field destination; jika dispatch, tampilkan field destination (wajib)
5. Net Weight dihitung reaktif = Gross Weight - Tare Weight setiap kali salah satu berubah, field disabled (tidak bisa diedit manual)

6. Render field dikelompokkan per section: Identitas Weighbridge (tombol tab Type, WB Card Number, field tanggal & waktu sesuai tipe, field Tujuan Muatan jika tipe dispatch), Kendaraan & Supir, Asal Muatan, Data Timbangan. Label Gross/Tare/Net Weight menampilkan '(kg)', label Kuantitas menampilkan '(tandan)'
7. Render breadcrumb (Home > Production Process Activity > Weighbridge > Form, tappable) dan header dengan hamburger

8. On Simpan: validasi field wajib (termasuk destination jika weighbridge_type=dispatch) → jika lengkap: UPDATE record (semua field termasuk weighbridge_type, record_datetime, destination, status=saved) → navigasi ke Monitor Weighbridge
9. On Pause: UPDATE record (field form saat ini apa adanya termasuk weighbridge_type/record_datetime/destination, status=draft_paused, TANPA validasi field wajib) → navigasi ke Monitor Weighbridge
10. On Clear: tampilkan dialog konfirmasi → jika dikonfirmasi: DELETE record → navigasi ke Monitor; jika dibatalkan: tidak ada perubahan
11. On Back: jika form dirty: tampilkan dialog konfirmasi → jika dikonfirmasi, buang perubahan di memori, navigasi ke Monitor; jika tidak dirty, navigasi langsung
12. On tap breadcrumb segment → navigasi ke route terkait
13. On tap hamburger → buka menu navigasi (Ganti Password, Logout)

data_operations.description: SELECT record by id untuk load form state
UPDATE semua field form (termasuk weighbridge_type, record_datetime, destination) + status=saved pada Simpan
UPDATE field form apa adanya + status=draft_paused pada Pause (tanpa validasi)
DELETE record pada Clear yang dikonfirmasi

edge_case_handling.condition: Field wajib belum lengkap saat Simpan (termasuk destination jika tipe dispatch)
edge_case_handling.handling: Tampilkan error inline per field, record tidak tersimpan
Field form terisi dari draft tersimpan (termasuk weighbridge_type dan record_datetime); tidak ada field tanggal yang di-reset untuk tipe manapun

edge_case_handling.condition: Ganti tipe Weighbridge setelah field tanggal/destination terisi
edge_case_handling.handling: Nilai lama dibuang, field baru menyesuaikan sesuai tipe yang baru dipilih (auto-set record_datetime sekali untuk tipe baru)
Tampilkan dialog konfirmasi wajib sebelum DELETE dieksekusi

business_rules_applied: Record tersimpan langsung, bukan approval workflow
Field wajib bertanda asterisk dengan validasi inline
Tipe Weighbridge default Receive, dapat diganti sebelum Simpan
Tanggal & Waktu Arrival otomatis sekali untuk tipe Receive
Tanggal & Waktu Dispatch otomatis sekali untuk tipe Dispatch (sama seperti Arrival)
Tujuan Muatan wajib diisi hanya saat tipe Dispatch
Net Weight dihitung otomatis dari Gross - Tare

unit_test_cases.description: sets weighbridge_type to 'receive' by default when loading a new draft (weighbridge_type absent)

unit_test_cases.given: weighbridgeRepo.findById() returns record with weighbridge_type = 'dispatch'
unit_test_cases.expect: form state weighbridge_type is set to 'dispatch' (not overwritten to default)

unit_test_cases.description: auto-sets record_datetime to current time when type=receive and stored value is empty (new draft or type just switched to receive)
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_type='receive', record_datetime empty/null
unit_test_cases.expect: record_datetime is set once to current system time and field becomes non-editable

unit_test_cases.description: preserves stored record_datetime when type=receive and value already set
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_type='receive', record_datetime has an existing stored value
unit_test_cases.expect: record_datetime retains the stored value; not overwritten with current time

unit_test_cases.description: auto-sets record_datetime to current time when type=dispatch and stored value is empty (new draft or type just switched to dispatch)
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_type='dispatch', record_datetime empty/null
unit_test_cases.expect: record_datetime is set once to current system time and field becomes non-editable (same behavior as receive, no continuous ticking)

unit_test_cases.description: preserves stored record_datetime when type=dispatch and value already set (draft resumed)
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_type='dispatch', record_datetime has an existing stored value
unit_test_cases.expect: record_datetime retains the stored value; not overwritten or re-ticked on resume

unit_test_cases.description: discards record_datetime and destination and reapplies auto-set-once logic when switching tab receive → dispatch
unit_test_cases.given: form has weighbridge_type='receive' with record_datetime set, destination hidden/empty; user taps 'dispatch' tab
unit_test_cases.expect: record_datetime is discarded then auto-set once to current time (not live-ticking); destination field becomes visible and required, with any prior value cleared

unit_test_cases.description: discards record_datetime and destination and reapplies auto-set-once logic when switching tab dispatch → receive
unit_test_cases.given: form has weighbridge_type='dispatch' with record_datetime set and destination filled; user taps 'receive' tab
unit_test_cases.expect: record_datetime is discarded then auto-set once to current time; destination field is hidden, cleared, and no longer required

unit_test_cases.description: computes Net Weight reactively as Gross Weight minus Tare Weight
unit_test_cases.given: Gross Weight = 5000, Tare Weight = 2000
unit_test_cases.expect: Net Weight field = 3000 and remains disabled/non-editable

unit_test_cases.description: recomputes Net Weight when Gross Weight or Tare Weight changes
unit_test_cases.given: Net Weight already computed as 3000; Tare Weight is subsequently updated to 2200
unit_test_cases.expect: Net Weight recomputes to (Gross Weight - 2200)

unit_test_cases.description: returns validation error when a required field is empty on Simpan (type=receive)
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_type='receive', WB Card Number (or another required field) is empty
unit_test_cases.expect: inline validation error shown per empty field; weighbridgeRepo.update() is not called; record is not saved

unit_test_cases.description: returns validation error when destination is empty on Simpan (type=dispatch)
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_type='dispatch', all fields filled except destination
unit_test_cases.expect: inline validation error shown for destination field; weighbridgeRepo.update() is not called; record is not saved

unit_test_cases.description: saves record with status=saved when Simpan is pressed with type=dispatch and all required fields valid
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_type='dispatch', all required fields including destination filled, record_datetime already auto-set
unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.update() called with status='saved' and the existing record_datetime unchanged (not modified at save time); navigation to Monitor Weighbridge is triggered

unit_test_cases.description: saves record with status=saved when Simpan is pressed with type=receive and all required fields valid
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridge_type='receive', all required fields filled, record_datetime already auto-set
unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.update() called with status='saved' and the existing record_datetime unchanged; navigation to Monitor Weighbridge is triggered

unit_test_cases.description: saves draft with status=draft_paused without validating required fields when Pause is pressed

unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.update() called with current field values as-is and status='draft_paused', no validation errors thrown; navigation to Monitor Weighbridge is triggered

unit_test_cases.description: deletes record and navigates to Monitor when Clear is confirmed
unit_test_cases.given: user confirms Clear dialog; weighbridgeRepo.delete() mocked to succeed
unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.delete() called with the record id; navigation to Monitor Weighbridge is triggered

unit_test_cases.description: makes no changes when Clear dialog is canceled
unit_test_cases.given: user cancels the Clear confirmation dialog
unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.delete() is not called; form state remains unchanged

unit_test_cases.description: shows confirmation dialog and discards in-memory changes on Back when form is dirty and confirmed
unit_test_cases.given: form state isDirty=true; user confirms the Back dialog
unit_test_cases.expect: in-memory changes are discarded (no repo write); navigation to Monitor Weighbridge is triggered

unit_test_cases.description: navigates directly on Back when form is not dirty
unit_test_cases.given: form state isDirty=false
unit_test_cases.expect: navigation to Monitor Weighbridge is triggered immediately, without showing a confirmation dialog

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: weighbridgeRepo.findById() returns a valid continued draft, weighbridge_type='dispatch', all required fields including destination are valid, weighbridgeRepo.update() resolves successfully
unit_test_cases.expect: record_datetime remains at its auto-set value (unchanged by Simpan), Net Weight correctly computed, weighbridgeRepo.update() resolves with the saved record (status='saved'), navigation to Monitor Weighbridge is triggered

implementation_notes: Simpan/Pause/Clear bersifat lokal (SQLite); pengiriman ke server terjadi lewat mekanisme sync manual terpisah, di luar scope screen ini

record_datetime TIDAK lagi butuh interval timer/live-ticking untuk tipe manapun — auto-set sekali (pola yang sama dengan Arrival versi lama) kini berlaku untuk Receive maupun Dispatch; ini menyederhanakan implementasi dibanding draft sebelumnya (tidak perlu setInterval, tidak perlu clear/restart timer saat ganti tipe atau unmount)
Checked By dihapus total dari layar ini — kolom checked_by di entity tetap ada di skema tapi tidak lagi dibaca/ditulis dari screen ini

arrival_datetime dan dispatch_datetime lama disatukan menjadi satu kolom record_datetime pada entity-catalog v5; label tampilan tetap berbeda sesuai weighbridge_type yang dipilih, namun perilaku pengisian (auto-set sekali, tidak dapat diedit) kini identik untuk kedua tipe
Field Tujuan Muatan (destination) baru, hanya dirender saat weighbridge_type=dispatch, wajib diisi saat itu

Label (kg) pada Gross/Tare/Net Weight dan (tandan) pada Kuantitas adalah teks statis pada label field, bukan perubahan tipe data/unit konversi — nilai tetap tersimpan sebagai angka polos di kolom yang sama
